config.notes: The user-data directory has the same layout on both platforms: Preferences, Bookmarks, extensions and per-profile directories all carry over. Cookies and saved passwords are sealed with the Windows DPAPI, so those are re-entered on Linux; they are secrets anyway and travel only with --secrets. Microsoft publishes its own apt and dnf repository for Edge; that is not a distribution repository, so only the AUR and Flathub are listed.
